explanation: God who became human to save the world from sin through his death and resurrection.
A friend of Jesus who had died, but whom Jesus raised back to life by a miracle.
The state in which the soul is separated from the body; in this chapter it is also seen as an enemy that Jesus defeats.
The act of rising from the dead, something Jesus promises will happen for all believers through his power.
The title Jesus uses for himself ("I am the resurrection and the life"), symbolizing eternal life through him.
Trust in God's power and promises, illustrated by Martha and Mary when they believe Jesus' words despite their situation.
